shellCommands.command: pwd && rg --files src/components/Tooltip src/test | head -80 && git status --short && rg -n "openOnClick|stopPropagation|addEventListener|click" src/components/Tooltip src/test/tooltip-interaction-behavior.spec.js
find src/components/Tooltip src/test -maxdepth 3 -type f | sort | head -100

sed -n '240,315p' src/test/tooltip-interaction-behavior.spec.js; grep -RIn "event-delegation\|document.*addEventListener\|listener.*count\|O(.*event" src/test src/components | head -80; grep -RIn "addDelegatedEventListener" src | head -30
grep -RIn "event delegation\|delegat" README.md docs src 2>/dev/null | head -80; git log -8 --oneline -- src/components/Tooltip/event-delegation.ts src/components/Tooltip/use-tooltip-events.tsx
git diff --check && git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- src/components/Tooltip/event-delegation.ts src/components/Tooltip/use-tooltip-events.tsx
